svg.title: Orders legacy-to-cloud migration architecture
svg.desc: Client traffic enters one global external HTTPS load balancer. Its URL map routes to either a legacy Compute Engine instance group or a Cloud Run serverless NEG. Cloud Run connects through Direct VPC egress and Private Services Access to private-IP Cloud SQL. Cloud SQL is outside the customer VPC. The source VM has no external IP; Cloud NAT provides scoped outbound bootstrap egress only.
svg.text: URL map · one active backend at a time
